source: Wikidata sitelinks (schema:about / schema:isPartOf) for the water and protected-area entity capture
what_absence_means: a language missing from an entity row means Wikidata states no sitelink to that edition, which is a measurement; an entity missing from the file was not answered and is listed in the .unanswered.txt sidecar
nothing_is_inferred: no title is transliterated or constructed; a title appears only where Wikidata states the sitelink
